title: Dang- it didn't double in 10 days.
author: DesertClimber
selftext:
Current balance is $8,752.77 (74% up) since Sept 9.  
  
Early projections had this real money test account doubling in ten days, but when the huge Bitcoin runup from \~$75k hit on Sept 16th (Currently above\~$86k now!) ... that threw my main bot for a loop. (It's a reversion algo) If it activates again, the projected line is the blue solid line, with the median projections being shaded.  
  
The rapid drawdown hit the brakes, and then paused that bot entirely... So 4 other bots are carrying the load, and making more frequent, but smaller trades. They don't mind the trend.  
  
I tried a few tweaks, but the heavy-hitter algo simply does not like the strong trend. I'm working on implementing another trend-style bot to toss in the mix, but it's not fully vetted. That would make 6 total, working the account by different methods- but for now I'll increase the account $% the others have access to.   
  
Currently running 4/5 bots on the account- If nothing changes, the account should be doubled from $5k to $10k by the end of the month instead of the projected 10 days. So sad. :(

Better than a poke in the eye, regardless! :)
